outcome: Antibody titers (levels) during the first two years of life
cohort: The study participants included 105 healthy women (from the 'born into life study') and their children.
finding: IgM anti-PC levels in children develop much slower than anti-MDA and remain relatively low at 2 years of age, while anti-MDA (IgM and IgG) and IgG anti-PC reach similar levels to mothers' earlier in life.
